# Midday alert: Tue 2026-11-17 (~12:30 PM ET)

**Managed care: sector-wide regulatory shock. Tickers: UNH, HUM, CVS, ELV, CNC, MOH.** CMS's proposed CRUSH anti-fraud rule (11/16) would make MA fraud reporting mandatory and re-propose RADV audits extrapolated back to 2018, with recoveries estimated at ~$9B per payment year ([HHS](https://www.hhs.gov/press-room/cms-crush-rule-targets-healthcare-fraud-saves-90-billion.html), [Becker's](https://www.beckerspayer.com/policy-updates/cms-targets-90b-in-savings-with-sweeping-new-anti-fraud-rule/)). Mizuho sees HUM and UNH as most exposed ([TipRanks/Fly](https://www.tipranks.com/news/the-fly/cms-proposal-negative-for-humana-and-unitedhealth-says-mizuho-thefly-news)). HUM was -5% in the morning, and Warren's call to break up insurers added to the pressure ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-humana-stock-sliding-today-93CH-5033405)).

**Desk action:** whole group is in avoid through 11/20. HUM swing idea pulled. The rule is still only proposed and will likely be litigated.

**Tape:** S&P -1.3%, Dow -1.7% at noon ahead of NVDA AMC ([24/7](https://247wallst.com/cards/the-selling-widened-through-lunchtime-with-the-dow-shedding-gspc-market-bell-01m7n7atq8q9dafm8zah4ham4n)).
